top_signals.title: Korean Chip Stocks Sink 10% in Pre-Market as AI Fears Deepen
top_signals.summary: South Korean chip stocks plummeted in pre-market trading, auguring a painful day for the region as fears deepened over how the Democrat sweep of Congress could slow AI infrastructure expansion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
top_signals.summary: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Linux accounts
top_signals.summary: A newly disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability dubbed "*sshole" allows attackers to log in to certain Alpine Linux and other musl-based Linux accounts that are configured to block password authentication, simply by entering an oversized password. [...]

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
